verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as bulk edit, bulk transition, or batch API endpoints that act on many issues at once. The REST API, JQL queries, and automation rules are developer building blocks or adjacent features that could be used to build bulk actions. They are not evidence that the product itself ships bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
